# omni_folder (Data Source)

Looks up an existing folder by path or ID.

Use this to grant access to a folder Terraform does not manage, such as a shared hub folder that content is published into. Referencing it here fails at plan time if it is missing, rather than applying cleanly and granting nothing.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The folder's unique ID. Give this or `path`.
- `path` (String) Full path, for example `reporting/finance`. Give this or `id`. Paths are lowercased by the API.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `owner_id` (String) The folder's owner.
- `scope` (String) `organization` or `restricted`.
- `url` (String) Direct link to the folder in the Omni UI.
